integrity: Proof gives a closed-form geometric fixed-point reduction and an unrestricted acyclic matching. Executable exhaustive spot checks over 189 finite parameter cases are corroboration rather than a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite paths under reversal only. General interval-family sphere-or-point existence is previously known; novelty concerns parity-sensitive all-parameter exact dimensions and criteria. No independent audit or claim of classification of general tree automorphisms.
title: Reflection-fixed homotopy types of higher path-independence complexes
